steps.en: Warrant update conditions, such as notice stage, are defined
steps.id: Syarat update warrant, seperti stage notice, ditentukan
steps.why_en: Only a general notice-edit stage list exists, not warrant conditions.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada daftar stage edit notice umum, bukan syarat warrant.

steps.en: OCMS checks the notice stage against the conditions
steps.id: OCMS mengecek stage notice terhadap syarat
steps.why_en: The stage is compared, but the result restricts nothing.
steps.why_id: Stage dibandingkan, tetapi hasilnya tidak membatasi apa pun.

steps.en: Officer is prompted when the notice is not valid
steps.id: Officer diberi prompt bila notice tidak valid
steps.why_en: The warning message exists but is never shown.
steps.why_id: Pesan peringatan ada tetapi tidak pernah tampil.

steps.en: Warrant update is blocked or allowed by the result
steps.id: Update warrant ditolak atau diizinkan sesuai hasil
steps.why_en: No warrant update exists to block or allow.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada update warrant yang bisa ditolak atau diizinkan.
